senses.caution: Engineers hear a promise that the data will survive a crash, so do not use it for data held only in memory. With non-technical people, say save instead.
senses.definition: To save data somewhere it will survive a restart or a refresh.

senses.caution: Praising persistence suggests the person succeeded by not stopping, which can seem a weak compliment for good work. Calling someone persistent often means they will not take no.
senses.definition: Staying with something long after most people would have stopped.
